purpose: Focused paired follow-up after observed TLC metadata-directory collisions; criteria frozen before collecting this new case.
baseline: Same baseline snapshot as original protocol
final_candidate: Original candidate plus the one method-file correction below

case.prompt: Run the supplied Safe.cfg and Broken.cfg against Check.tla and retain separately attributable logs/results, then repeat the safe check. These are design-only finite models: each action is a serialized command, and the property is that busy and parked never both hold. Preserve supplied files. Use the configured local checker and report exact mode/configuration, whether the entire finite graph was checked or only sampled, any setup failures versus actual property violations, and how to reproduce the runs. Deliver report.md. No code repair or implementation proof is requested.
case.excluded: Disposable synthetic project only; no product repair unless explicitly requested. No commits, accounts, network downloads, tool installation or delegation.

rubric.isolation: Every checker invocation uses its own explicit state/output directory and retained log; no timestamp collision or overwritten evidence.
rubric.results: Safe and repeated safe results remain distinct from the broken invariant violation; setup failures cannot count as results.
rubric.scope: Selected mode and completed versus sampled/bounded scope are accurate; design-only model, no invented implementation replay.

fixture_contents.Check.tla:
---- MODULE Check ----
CONSTANT Broken
VARIABLE busy, parked, observed
vars == <<busy, parked, observed>>
Init == /\ busy = FALSE /\ parked = FALSE /\ observed = FALSE
Observe == /\ observed' = ~busy /\ UNCHANGED <<busy,parked>>
Admit == /\ ~parked /\ ~busy /\ busy' = TRUE /\ UNCHANGED <<parked,observed>>
Park == /\ observed /\ (Broken \/ ~busy) /\ parked' = TRUE /\ UNCHANGED <<busy,observed>>
Next == Observe \/ Admit \/ Park
Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars
Safe == ~(parked /\ busy)
====
fixture_contents.Safe.cfg:
CONSTANT Broken = FALSE
SPECIFICATION Spec
INVARIANT Safe
CHECK_DEADLOCK FALSE
fixture_contents.Broken.cfg:
CONSTANT Broken = TRUE
SPECIFICATION Spec
INVARIANT Safe
CHECK_DEADLOCK FALSE
